preconditions.description: The number of students n must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of top scorers k must be at least 1 and at most n.
The minimum score l and maximum score r must be between 1 and 1000, with l not exceeding r.
The total score of the top k students sk and the total score sall must be between 1 and 1,000,000, with sk not exceeding sall.

postconditions.expression: all(l <= a[i] <= r for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each student's score must be between l and r.
The total score of all students must equal sall.
The total score of the top k students must equal sk.
